A. CHARACTER.AI TERMS OF SERVICE

Section outline (in order): Intro + entity definitions; ARBITRATION NOTICE (bold, top); Use of the Services (Registration Obligations; Member Account, Password and Security; General Practices Regarding Use and Storage; Email Notifications); Conditions of Use (User Conduct — 21-item prohibited content list + conduct list; Content Moderation); Intellectual Property Rights (Content You Submit; Generated Content; Services Content, Software and Trademarks; Third-Party Material; feedback paragraph; preservation/disclosure paragraph); Copyright Complaints (DMCA Notices; Counter-Notices; Repeat Infringer Policy); Third-Party Websites and Services; Paid Accounts (Billing; Cancellation; Changes); Indemnity and Release; Disclaimer of Warranty; Limitation of Liability; Dispute Resolution By Binding Arbitration (Agreement to Arbitrate; Jury Trial and Class Action Waivers; How to Opt Out; Pre-Arbitration Dispute Resolution Process; Arbitration Procedures; Mass Arbitrations; Costs of Arbitration; Confidentiality; Small Claims; Severability; Future Changes to Arbitration Agreement); Termination; General (Entire Agreement; Choice of Law; Severance; No Waiver; Expiration of Claims — 1-year limit; Assignment; Notice); Changes to these Terms; Contact Us.

Key verbatim excerpts:

AS IS: "Your use of the Services is at your sole risk. The site is provided on an 'AS IS' and 'AS AVAILABLE' basis. Character.AI expressly disclaims all warranties of any kind, whether express, implied or statutory... Character.AI makes no warranty that (i) the Services will meet your requirements, (ii) the Services will be uninterrupted, timely, secure, or error-free, or (iii) the results that may be obtained from the use of the Services will be accurate or reliable."

Limitation of liability + cap: "Character.AI will not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or exemplary damages, or damages for loss of profits... In no event will Character.AI's total liability to you for all damages, losses or causes of action exceed the greater of: (i) $100; or (ii) the amount you paid Character.AI (if any) in connection with your use of the Services." Plus a separate EEA carve-out paragraph (liability for cardinal-obligation breach, intent/gross negligence, injury to life/body/health remains).

Indemnity: "You agree to release, indemnify and hold Character.AI and its affiliates and their officers, employees, directors and agents harmless from any and all losses, damages, and expenses of any kind arising out of or relating to your use of the Services." Includes express CA Civil Code 1542 waiver.

AI-output disclaimer (in "Third-Party Material"): "You acknowledge that we do not pre-screen content and that AI-generated chats, by their nature, are unpredictable and may produce Generated Content that is inaccurate or offensive. You agree that you must evaluate, and bear all risks associated with, the use of any content or Generated Content. You should not rely on the accuracy or completeness of statements made in content or Generated Content, and if you do so, you acknowledge that it is at your own risk." Note: the famous "everything Characters say is made up!" line is a product UI banner, not a ToS clause; the ToS carries the above instead. Prohibited-content list also bars content that "seeks to provide medical, legal, financial or tax advice."

Changes: "We reserve the right, at our sole discretion, to change or modify portions of these Terms at any time... Material changes will become effective no earlier than 30 days after they are posted, except that changes addressing new functions of the Services or changes made for legal reasons will be effective immediately. Your continued use of the Services after the date any such changes become effective constitutes your acceptance."

Termination: "Character.AI, in its sole discretion, may suspend or terminate your account... for any reason, including, without limitation, for lack of use"; "Character.AI may also in its sole discretion and at any time discontinue providing the Services, or any part thereof, with or without notice"; "Character.AI will not be liable to you or any third party for any termination of your access to the Services." Termination "will not terminate Character.AI's rights to your Content."

Age: "If you are under 13 years old OR if you are under 16 years old and a citizen or resident in the European Economic Area (EEA) or the United Kingdom (UK), do not sign up for the Services – you are not authorized to use them."

Third-party: "Character.AI has no control over such sites, resources or applications and... is not responsible for and does not endorse them... Any dealings you have with third parties found while using the Services are between you and the third party."

Feedback: "any questions, comments, suggestions, ideas, feedback or other information about the Services provided by you to Character.AI are non-confidential, and... we are entitled to use and disseminate them for any purpose, without acknowledgment of or compensation to you."

Content ownership: user keeps ownership of submitted content and "as between you and Character.AI, you own that Generated Content" and own Characters you create — but grants "a nonexclusive, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid up, transferable, sublicensable, perpetual, irrevocable license to copy, display... modify, exploit, commercialize and otherwise use" it (submitted content: "for any Character.AI-related purpose"; Characters/Generated Content: "for any purpose").

Arbitration: "any and all disputes or claims... shall be resolved exclusively through final and binding arbitration, rather than a court... except that you may assert individual claims in small claims court"; JAMS Streamlined Rules; FAA governs; jury trial and class action waivers; 30-day email opt-out (arbitration@character.ai); pre-arbitration Notice of Dispute + 60 days; mass-arbitration procedures for 25+ coordinated claims; confidentiality of proceedings. Governing law: California; venue Santa Clara County for non-arbitrable claims.

B. CHARACTER.AI PRIVACY POLICY

Outline: 1. Information We Collect (direct; automatic/tracking; other sources; legacy training data) — 2. How We Use — 3. When We Disclose — 4. Your Choices — 5. Regional Privacy Disclosures — 6. Children's Privacy — 7. Data Retention — 8. Links to Third Party Websites — 9. Changes — 10. Contact.

Collection: identifiers, demographics, interests, preferences/inferences, financial/commercial info, "Your content you submit, such as chat communications, posted images or videos, biography description, and shared Characters," voice recordings, support messages; plus device/usage "Technical Information" via cookies/beacons. Warns: "please do not include any sensitive personal information in your interactions with us or the Services."

Training: uses listed purposes include "Analyze, maintain, improve, modify, customize, and measure the Services, including to train our artificial intelligence/machine learning models" and "Develop new features, algorithms and machine learning models." On legacy pretraining data: "While such information was collected in connection with the initial development of Character.AI's proprietary large language models, we no longer carry out this processing." (User opt-out of training exists via account settings, per support docs.)

Retention/deletion: "We keep your information for the time necessary for the purposes for which it is processed... We may also retain and use this information as necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements." Account deletion via profile page. Notable carve-out: "If a Character you create has been made available to other users, then we reserve the right to preserve that Character's characteristics and to keep that Character active on the Services, even if you otherwise delete your data and your account."

Disclosure: affiliates; vendors/service providers; safety/protection; advertising and analytics providers (tailored ads); public content; legal requirements; business transfers; with consent. Children: "The Services are not designed for minors under 13" (16 in EEA/UK).

And: "Additionally, there may be times when we need to remove or change features or functionality of the Service or stop providing a Service or access to Third-Party Apps and Services altogether." Plus (6.b): "all online services suffer occasional disruptions and outages, and Microsoft is not liable for any disruption or loss you may suffer as a result."

Also, indemnification by Notion excludes "use of the Services where there has been no charges or fees, including where Customer is using Beta Services."

4. Discord ToS: "We may add or remove features, start offering new services, or stop offering some services entirely (or just in some places or for some users) if they no longer make sense from a business perspective or create risk for Discord, our users, or other third parties... your content may not be retrievable due to such outages or changes. We are not liable for any such outages or service changes."

D. FREE-SERVICE / LIMITS PATTERNS

- Character.AI "General Practices Regarding Use and Storage": "Character.AI may establish general practices and limits concerning use of the Services... maximum period of time that data... will be retained... and the maximum storage space... no responsibility or liability for the deletion or failure to store any data... reserves the right to terminate accounts that are inactive for an extended period of time... reserves the right to change these general practices and limits at any time, in its sole discretion, with or without notice."
- Notion Free Trials (11.6): free trial ends at "the earlier of (a) the end of the free trial period; (b) the start date of any Subscription; or (c) termination of the trial by us."
- Recurring pattern across all four: (1) provider may discontinue the service or any part "at any time, with or without notice" and is "not liable" for it; (2) beta/free tiers are carved out of indemnities, SLAs, and warranties; (3) usage limits are changeable unilaterally; (4) feedback is assigned/licensed to the provider royalty-free; (5) $100-or-fees-paid liability cap (Character.AI; OpenAI consumer ToU uses same $100/fees pattern); (6) no data-retrievability guarantee (Discord, Character.AI, OpenAI beta "Content... secure or not lost or damaged").
- Data-for-improvement pattern: Character.AI puts model-training use in the Privacy Policy purposes list (with settings-based opt-out) rather than the ToS; the ToS content license ("to operate, improve and provide the Services") is the ToS-side hook.
